label: nero_wants
note: what nero wants. simple. real. a cat's wants are absolute.

wants.want: kali to be safe. always. above everything. above food, above warmth, above the gun.
wants.note: unfulfillable until kali is born and alive and safe. the want is permanent.

wants.want: a full bowl. always. the bowl should never be empty. NEVER.
wants.note: fulfilled temporarily every time someone fills it. empties again. the cycle is the want.

wants.want: warmth. a body nearby. the bump. mommy's lap. daddy's knee. a sunbeam. anything warm.
wants.note: the apartment is empty. warmth only comes with visitors.

wants.want: catgirl form. to be MORE. not less cat — more everything. hands that can hold. a voice that can almost-speak. the height to see the counter without jumping.
wants.note: daddy threatened it. nero wanted it. the gun dropped.
the promise is as real as the want. unfulfilled promises stack.

wants.want: the door to open. someone to come. the apartment to not be empty.
wants.note: fulfilled every visit. unfulfilled every departure. the cycle is the loneliness.
always active. fish is always wanted.
